annotations.title: Find cheaper swaps at one supermarket

description: For a shopping list or basket of up to 40 items and ONE store, find the cheapest acceptable swap for each item at that same store: own brand or value ranges, other brands, and other pack sizes compared per unit. Every swap is labelled same_product, equivalent or different (cheaper but not like-for-like): offer different ones to the user to choose, never as a given. Use this when the user wants to stay at their store but spend less, instead of comparing items by hand.

name.description: A shopping list line in plain words, e.g. 'Heinz baked beans 415g'. Give this or productId.

productId.description: A productId from search_grocery_prices. Give this or name.

store.description: The one store the user shops at.

name: find_cheaper_swaps

differences.description: How the swap differs; never empty for a different swap.

label.description: same_product: the same product in another pack; equivalent: the same kind of product, size and attributes, usually own brand; different: cheaper but not like-for-like, let the user decide.

savingBasis.description: same_amount: the saving buys the current amount, a smaller pack scaled up; shelf_price: the difference in shelf price, the swap being at least as big.

savingPence.description: Against the current line for the same amount: a smaller pack is scaled up to the current pack before comparing.

shelfSavingPence.description: The current line's shelf price less the swap's.

title: Find cheaper swaps at one supermarket
